area_method: Count 30m grid-cell centres allocated to exactly one GN and multiply by pixel area; values are approximate.
interpretation: GN statistics describe relative susceptibility indices and scenario sensitivity, not observed flood frequency or waterlogging probabilities.
limitations: Land-cover screening is based on 2020 classification, not current ground truth.
Building density is derived from 2026 OSM mapping.
Model-sensitivity measures are not statistical confidence intervals.
Raster-cell areas approximate GN polygon areas.
Paddy, wetland and open-water areas are reported separately from general land rather than treated as zero risk.
No independent predictive accuracy is claimed.
Seasonal timing and flood depth are not predicted.
